lines.en: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
lines.zh: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。

lines.en: What does she mean by 'change' in the last sentence?
lines.zh: 在最后一句话中，她说的“零钱”是什么意思？

lines.en: When my husband was going into the dining room this morning,
lines.zh: 今天早上我丈夫走进饭厅时，

lines.en: he dropped some coins on the floor.
lines.zh: 他把一些硬币掉在地板上了。

lines.en: We looked for them, but we could not find them all.
lines.zh: 我们找了找，但没有把它们全都找到。

lines.en: our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins on the floor.
lines.zh: 我们的小儿子汤米在地板上找到了两枚小硬币。

lines.en: He put them both into his mouth.
lines.zh: 他把两枚硬币都放进了嘴里。

lines.en: We both tried to get the coins, but it was too late.
lines.zh: 我们俩都想把硬币拿出来，但是太晚了。
汤米已经把它们吞下去了！

lines.en: Late that morning, when I was doing the housework,
lines.zh: 早上晚些时候，我正在做家务时，

lines.en: My husband phoned me from the office.
lines.zh: 我丈夫从办公室给我打了个电话。

lines.en: 'Tommy's been to the toilet three times this morning, but I haven't had any change yet!'
lines.zh: “今天上午汤米已经上过三次厕所了，但我还没见到有任何‘零钱’呢！”
